rule: Breast Cancer: mean accuracy Qlassifier - ZZ QSVC >= 20 pp
mean BA Qlassifier > ZZ QSVC on all 5 datasets; paired win rate >= 0.8 on each
mean BA >= published - 1 pp on >= 3 of 4 UCI sets (0.968 / 0.911 / 0.813 / 0.804)
mean BA >= published on >= 2 of 4 UCI sets
mean BA over the 4 UCI sets: Qlassifier highest among the in-harness quantum models
≥ 1 dataset: mean BA above every tuned classical model and corrected 95% CI of Δ vs best classical > 0 (stretch; report-only, ADR 0004)
